USE IT

Most people own things they rarely use. USE IT lets them rent it out — and lets everyone else stop buying stuff they only need once.

My Role

I focused on product definition, UX research, and user flows — mapping the needs of both renters and lenders, and translating them into wireframes. I also helped shape the pitch narrative.
